title: ID0432958-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001031]-EVSE_TempUpperLimit
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Charger offline in both backends. Before going offline, last OCPP message was
EVSE_TempUpperLimit and SafetyRelay_QA26.
Root Cause
:
-BT3 temp and humid sensor connection were cross connected in terminal block +F03-XD6 2D and 4D.
This has happened in factory -->
latent fault -->
Warranty case.
Solution:
Upon arriving at the site 23.6.2025 and opening the front door, the heater was operational. I turned off the power from the charger and turned it back on, but the heater started working again. I repeated this numerous times, but the charger did not start. I began examining the temperature and humidity sensors connected to the Siemens LOGO and noticed that the wiring of one sensor was crossed. The temperature was connected to the humidity input and the humidity sensor to the temperature input. After correcting the wiring, the charger started.
The cause was therefore incorrect wiring done at the factory, resulting in a latent fault. The site had been visited previously for the same fault, during which the LOGO was updated and the charger started.
